SUMMARY: This factory builds a procedural palm tree: a single tall curved trunk with ring scars/cracks, topped by a crown of large arching pinnate fronds (each frond made of many narrow leaflets radiating in a sector). palm_tree.py assembles the trunk curve, bark shader, crown placement, and instances a frond asset generated by LeafPalmPlantFactory (leaf_palm_plant.py), which builds each pinnate leaf blade using shared leaf-generation nodegroups in tropic_plant_utils.py.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/tropic_plants/palm_tree.py
  PalmTreeFactory.create_asset: entry point; builds one frond, sets trunk params, applies geometry, final scale.
    knobs: leaf_x_curvature(uniform 0.1-0.3) -> frond arch/downward curl; plant_z_rotate(uniform 0.0-0.02) -> frond twist; stem_x_curvature(fixed 0.0); stem_y_curvature(uniform -0.1..0.1) -> frond side-bend; plant_stem_length(uniform 0.5-1.2) -> frond length; trunk_radius(uniform 0.2-0.3) -> trunk thickness; obj.scale(fixed (2,2,2)) -> overall size
  geometry_palm_tree_nodes: assembles trunk curve, crown sphere, frond instancing, optional dead-leaf skirt.
    knobs: truncatedstem_chance(gin, 0.4) -> probability of dead hanging leaf stems below crown; trunk_height(fixed 5.0) -> trunk length before scaling; top_x/top_y(normal 0,0.5) -> lean direction/amount of trunk top; bezier Middle Z(uniform 1.5-3.0) -> where trunk bows; resample Length(0.02) -> trunk mesh density; top_segment(randint 8-14) -> fronds around crown; top_ring(randint 10-15) -> vertical crown rings; uv_sphere Radius(uniform 0.15-0.2) -> crown hub size; transform Scale Z(uniform 0.8-2.0) -> crown vertical stretch
  nodegroup_trunk_radius: trunk radius profile with per-ring scar bumps.
    knobs: RandomValue(0.01-0.05) -> base radius jitter; map_range 3:1.0 4:0.2 -> taper top-to-bottom; float_curve pts -> scar shape; multiply_1 factor(uniform 0.1-0.25) -> scar depth
  nodegroup_tree_cracks: adds voronoi crack displacement to bark.
    knobs: multiply factor(uniform 0.1-0.25) -> crack vertical stretch; voronoi Scale(400.0)/Randomness(10.0) -> crack density/irregularity; colorramp positions(0.6091/0.6818) -> crack width; final multiply(-0.01) -> crack depth
  nodegroup_tree_trunk_geometry: trunk mesh from curve.
    knobs: TrunkResolution(32) -> trunk roundness; TrunkRadius(=radius arg); SubdivideMesh Level(2) -> smoothness
  nodegroup_leaf_on_top: places/rotates/scales fronds on crown.
    knobs: random scale RandomValue(0.5-1.0) -> frond size variation; leaf_instance_selection_bottom_remove Segment-4 -> how many lower rings culled (crown fullness); random cull removes 1 extra frond
  nodegroup_truncated_stem_geometry: dead hanging leaf skirt.
    knobs: scale RandomValue(max 0.6) -> dead leaf size; modulo randint(6-10) -> fraction removed; petal_z_coutour_scale(uniform 0.2-0.4)
  nodegroup_truncated_leaf_selection: which dead leaves survive.
    knobs: multiply_1 factor(uniform 0.98-0.99); multiply_2 clip(normal 0.65,0.2)
  nodegroup_coutour_cross_geometry: dead-leaf cross-section.
    knobs: petal_cross_coutour_x(0.3)/petal_cross_coutour_y(0.3) -> leaf cross shape; curve_circle Radius(0.05)/Resolution(128)
  shader_trunk: bark material.
    knobs: d_hsv(hue 0.02-0.05, sat branch 0.01-0.05|0.5-0.8, val 0.03-0.09) -> bark base color; b_hsv val(0.1-0.3); voronoi_texture_1 Scale(20); wave Scale(uniform 1-3); ring-scar voronoi Scale(100)/Randomness(10) -> dark ring lines; mix Fac(uniform 0.1-0.3)
  shader_top_core: dead-leaf/core material.
    knobs: voronoi Scale(uniform 100-400); d_hsv(hue 0.02-0.05, sat 0.3-0.6, val 0.01-0.05); b_hsv(sat 0.6-0.9, val 0.3-0.6); colorramp positions(0.2409/0.6045)

FILE: assets/objects/tropic_plants/leaf_palm_plant.py
  LeafPalmPlantFactory.update_params: samples per-frond shape parameters.
    knobs: leaf_h_wave mode(choice flat 0.7 / s 0.3) -> leaflet undulation profile; leaf_h_wave_scale(uniform 0.01-0.15) -> undulation amplitude; leaf_x_curvature(uniform 0.0-0.5) -> leaflet lengthwise curl; stem_x_curvature(uniform -0.1..0.4); stem_y_curvature(uniform -0.15..0.15); plant_z_rotate(uniform -0.4..0.4); plant_stem_length(uniform 1.5-2.2) -> rachis length; plant_scale(uniform 0.8-1.3)
  geometry_plant_nodes: builds rachis + leaflet sector + assembly.
    knobs: leaf_width_scale(uniform 0.15-0.2) -> leaflet width; integer/randint(20-30) -> leaflet count per frond (resolution); leaf_scale(uniform 0.85-1.25) -> frond blade size
  nodegroup_stem_geometry: rachis mesh.
    knobs: map_range 0.4-0.8 -> rachis taper; curve_circle Radius(uniform 0.03-0.06) -> rachis thickness
  nodegroup_leaf_palm_instance: single leaflet generation.
    knobs: SubdivideMesh Level(10) -> leaflet mesh density; leaf_gen params Vein Asymmetry(0.3023), Vein Angle(0.3), Midrib Length(0.3336), Midrib Width(1.3), Stem Length(0.6) -> leaflet blade profile; sub_vein multiply(0.0005) -> vein bump
  nodegroup_palmleafsector: arranges leaflets around a circle into a fan.
    knobs: curve_circle Radius(0.01); Resolution1(default 26, set to leaflet count); palm_leaf_assemble random scale(0.9-1.1) -> per-leaflet size jitter
  nodegroup_stem_curvature: bends rachis.
    knobs: resample Count(100); Y/X Stem Rotate (from params)
  shader_leaf_material: frond leaf color.
    knobs: main_leaf_hsv(hue uniform 0.3-0.36, sat 0.6-0.7, val 0.2-0.3) -> green leaf color; noise Scale(6.8)/Detail(10)/Roughness(0.7) -> color mottling; stem_color_hsv val offset(uniform 0.05-0.15) -> midrib darkening
  get_h_wave_contour: leaflet wave control-point presets ('flat' small noise, 's' S-curve).

FILE: assets/objects/tropic_plants/tropic_plant_utils.py
  Shared leaf-generation nodegroups (midrib, veins, jigsaw edges, shape contour, shaders) used by leaflet blades.
    knobs: nodegroup_nodegroup_shape leaf_contour_control_points -> leaflet outline silhouette (passed in, else default curve); nodegroup_nodegroup_leaf_shader mix Facs(0.2 glossy, 0.3 translucent) -> leaf sheen/translucency; shader_stem_material stem_color_hsv(hue 0.25-0.32, sat 0.6-0.9, val 0.2-0.6) -> rachis color; sub_vein voronoi Scales(30/150) -> fine vein texture

FILE: assets/objects/tropic_plants/__init__.py
  Exports factories (PalmTreeFactory and siblings). No knobs.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/__init__.py -> assets package init
  assets/utils/object.py -> mesh/object helper utilities
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py -> NodeWrangler API for building geometry/shader node graphs

  core/nodes/compatibility.py -> Blender version node compatibility shims
  core/nodes/utils.py -> low-level node graph utilities
  core/surface.py -> add_geomod / add_material / shaderfunc_to_material
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class
  core/placement/detail.py -> level-of-detail / resampling
  core/tags.py -> semantic tagging
  core/util/blender.py -> butil (object select/delete/context helpers)
  core/util/color.py -> hsv2rgba color conversion
  core/util/math.py -> math helpers
  core/util/random.py -> randomized sampling helpers
  core/util/logging.py -> logging
  core/__init__.py, core/nodes/__init__.py, core/placement/__init__.py, core/util/__init__.py -> package inits
